title: Cycle Pulse: Predictive Microtriage & Soft-Descope Playbook
creator: Ava Collins
description:
Problem: During the last two cycles we consistently hit cross-team capacity cliffs in week 2 and 3 leading to reactive scope cuts that hurt OKR continuity. We lack a lightweight, repeatable decision process for safely compressing scope early and activating short-term staffing rotations for urgent deliveries.

Background: Existing cycle playbooks focus on large-scale surges and microtranches, but teams request a smaller-footprint runbook they can execute without heavy ops involvement. The goal is a predictive microtriage flow that pairs a quantitative capacity signal with a qualitative scope shepherd checklist and a lightweight staffing shadow rota.

Proposal summary: Build a "Cycle Pulse" playbook and tooling bundle that includes: 1) a small telemetry dashboard (predictive burn + role-level slack) that emits a single-cycle-risk score; 2) a decision matrix for soft-descope options (deferred, narrow-scope flag, opt-in non-blocking GA); 3) a rotating two-week on-call surge list for cross-functional shadowing; 4) one-page runbook templates and a Slack workflow to trigger the process. The playbook emphasizes predictable tradeoffs to preserve top-priority OKRs and avoid ad-hoc requests.

Why now: We expect increased Dedicated and Private onboarding in Q2; reducing mid-cycle firefighting improves velocity for revenue-impacting work and reduces on-call burnout.
acceptance_criteria:
- Telemetry dashboard live and linked in console: shows cycle risk score + per-role slack (engineer, infra, design, pm).
- Runbook annotated with decision matrix and two example descope actions per initiative.
- Slack workflow deployable: triggers runbook, creates a triage thread, and notifies surge rota.
- At least 3 teams run a pilot cycle using the playbook and report reduced last-minute scope cuts in retrospective.
- Post-pilot retrospective with documented changes to playbook and clear ownership.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (2w): prototype dashboard query and one-pager runbook; identify pilot teams (infra, console, runtime).
Phase 1 (3w): build Slack workflow, integrate with cycle calendar, establish surge rota scheduler.
Phase 2 (4w): run pilots across 3 teams for a full cycle, collect metrics + qualitative feedback.
Phase 3 (2w): iterate and bake into CycleOps playbook; create template in Confluence and a repo with Slack workflow code.
metrics:
Primary: percent of mid-cycle scope cuts labeled 'reactive' reduced by 50% across pilot teams.
Secondary: mean time from risk score trigger to triage thread creation < 1 working day.
Operational: rotation compliance >= 80% (surge rota members pick up shift).
Qualitative: pilot team NPS >= 7 on 'predictability of cycle commitments'.
risks:
- Metric noise: predictive burn may over-index to short bursts and cause unnecessary descope. Mitigation: use smoothing window and human-in-the-loop triage.
- Cross-team coordination friction for surge rota. Mitigation: limit rota to 2 engineers + 1 PM per org boundary for first two pilots.
- Tooling scope creep: keep Slack workflow minimal; avoid multi-step approvals.
